summary: Iter209 backend validation of Option A (chart_accounts as single source of truth for opening cash). Seeded a chart cash account with starting_balance=12345 on an active sub-location, then validated /api/financial/accounts new schema, formula, legacy fallback, admin-only migration endpoint (idempotent), plus trial-balance and repair-orphaned-journals regressions. All 9 pytest cases passed.
critical_code_review_comments: financial.py list_sublocation_accounts uses chart_start > 0 to decide source; a location whose chart accounts intentionally have starting_balance=0 will silently fall back to the legacy field. Acceptable per current design, but worth surfacing in the UI as 'no opening cash configured' vs 'legacy'.

repair_starting_balances: on second run of the endpoint, legacy financial_accounts.starting_balance rows are already zeroed so the aggregate cursor returns nothing → migrated=[], created=[], skipped=[]. That matches idempotency but means the 'skipped_already_migrated' count is only populated when there's a race window; the docstring implies it will reflect prior migrations too. Cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 chart cash account 'TEST_iter209_opening' (starting_balance=12345 UGX) on the first sub-location of the first campus. Kept active=True; teardown deactivates + zeroes starting_balance so subsequent test runs are clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration endpoint has already been executed by these tests, so legacy financial_accounts.starting_balance is now 0 across all rows. The seeded chart account may still exist (deactivated) unless the fixture teardown succeeded — safe to leave alone.
